lines.t: You make me move, You make me move in ways I can’t explain
Holy Spirit groove, I feel that fire runnin’ through my veins
Every step I take, Lord, You’re the one that’s guiding me
Yeah, I’m alive in You — Yahushua, You move in me
Ayy, woke up blessed, I’m steppin’ out, I’m walkin’ with Your name (woo!)
Devil tried to press me, but I’m built for pressure, mane (skrrt!)
Got that Scripture on me, yeah, I’m armored when I roll (yeah!)
I ain’t perfect, but Your mercy keep on cleanin’ up my soul
Ayy, light on me — that shine don’t fade (nope!)
Faith too big — that fear won’t stay (nah!)
I’m redeemed — that debt You paid
So I’m movin’ with the Spirit every single day
